description: Math left as LaTeX delimiters or plain text instead of PreTeXt math markup — the core of what math_notation exists to catch. Line 16 (unmarked math in prose) is the hardest of the four and the likeliest false negative.

expected.label: unmarked-math-in-prose
expected.note: The expression b^2 - 4ac is mathematics written as plain text; it should be <m>b^2 - 4ac</m>.
